title: As a fresh-laptop developer I want a healthy seeded stack from a fresh clone so that I can evaluate the platform in under ten minutes
value: Fresh clone to healthy seeded stack in <600s, Docker-first, zero host dependencies
acceptance_criteria: Given a clean machine with only Docker installed, when the developer runs `task up`, then all 4 services reach Up state and `curl -sf localhost:9000/health` returns 200 in <600s cold-cache (verify: tmp/B2B-Commerce/test-results/startup-time-*.txt elapsed<600)
why: Setup friction is the #1 developer-adoption killer; first impression decides fork-or-walk
what_if_missing: No reproducible bootstrap means forking the platform is a gamble and evaluation stalls before any value is seen
business_value: Operability + Speed pillars for the fresh-laptop developer: a trustworthy fork/contribute path that proves local-first onboarding works
purpose: Prove local-first onboarding is real and reproducible on any machine
critical_thinking: Docker-first with zero host pnpm/npm install; cold-cache timing is the honest gate (warm-cache hides the real first-run cost); edge case = slow network pulling images counts against the 600s budget

title: As a platform-operator I want a single Taskfile entrypoint for up/down/seed/health/test so that automation is consistent across machines
value: One idempotent task runner is the single source of truth for all local automation
acceptance_criteria: Given the repo, when the operator runs `task seed` twice in a row, then both invocations exit 0 (idempotent) and `task health` gates on backend HTTP 200 before reporting success (verify: exit code 0 on second seed run)
why: Ad-hoc shell scripts cause environment drift and machine-specific breakage
what_if_missing: Inconsistent ops across machines erodes trust and makes every onboarding a debugging session
business_value: Operability pillar for the platform-operator: one SSOT for automation eliminates drift and makes the stack reproducible
purpose: Establish KISS operability with a single documented entrypoint
critical_thinking: Taskfile.yml is the only entrypoint; risk = silent-skip where `task health` exits 0 when the backend is unreachable, producing a false-green (must hard-fail on non-200)

title: As an admin/sales-manager I want company/quote/approval domain modules as a reusable plugin so that the B2B procurement wedge has a real domain model
value: B2B domain modules (company, quote, approval) established as a reusable plugin surface, not bespoke app code
acceptance_criteria: Given the backend boots, when modules load, then company/quote/approval modules register and their migration snapshots are present (verify: apps/backend/src/modules/{company,quote,approval}/ exist + migrations snapshot files present)
why: Without a B2B domain model there is no regulated-procurement wedge to differentiate from generic ecommerce
what_if_missing: Cannot model company, quote, or approval entities; the entire B2B value proposition is impossible
business_value: Control + Auditability pillars: the product's core domain that every downstream B2B feature builds on
purpose: Establish the product's core domain via borrow-as-init-draft then own the IP from v0.1.0
critical_thinking: Plugin surface (not bespoke app code) so it remains forkable; edge case = module load order must not assume seed data exists

title: As an admin/sales-manager I want admin routes for Company/Quote/Approval so that I can onboard buyers and act on quotes
value: Admin can manage companies, quotes, and approvals from the admin UI
acceptance_criteria: Given an admin logged into /app, when they open admin company/quote/approval routes, then each route renders its management panel (verify: apps/backend/src/admin/ routes render Company, Quote, Approval; /app/companies returns 200)
why: The approver/admin persona is invisible without admin routes
what_if_missing: No approver UI leaves half the golden path missing and the admin ICP unrepresented
business_value: Control + Auditability pillars for the admin/sales-manager: the onboarding-and-approval side of the dual-persona wedge
purpose: Make the admin/sales-manager ICP visible and operable (anti INVISIBLE_PRIMARY_USER, admin side)
critical_thinking: Logically sequenced after DC-010 (modules must exist), but independently testable once DC-010 is in place; counter-view = admin routes are Medusa-native scaffolding, so risk is low

title: As a buyer-employee I want account/quotes/company/approvals storefront pages so that I can self-serve procurement without contacting sales
value: Buyer-employee can view their account, quotes, company, and approval status in a company-scoped storefront
acceptance_criteria: Given a buyer logged into the storefront, when they open /account quotes/company/approvals pages, then each renders with company-scoped data (verify: apps/storefront/src/modules/account/components/ render; /account/quotes returns 200)
why: The buyer-employee is the often-invisible primary user who actually triggers procurement value
what_if_missing: No buyer UI means the demo collapses on first run and the primary value-trigger persona is hidden
business_value: Speed + Compliance pillars for the buyer-employee: self-serve procurement that respects company scope
purpose: Make the buyer-employee ICP visible (anti INVISIBLE_PRIMARY_USER, buyer side)
critical_thinking: Sequenced after DC-011 but independently testable; edge case = a buyer with no company must see an empty-but-valid state, not a 500

title: As a buyer-employee I want my cart blocked when it exceeds my company spending limit so that I cannot over-commit company funds
value: Per-employee spending caps are enforced in software at cart level before a quote/order is created
acceptance_criteria: Given a buyer with a 10000 AUD cap and a cart totalling >10000 AUD, when they attempt to convert the cart, then the completion is blocked with a spending-limit message and no quote/order is created (verify: apps/backend/src/workflows/hooks/validate-cart-completion.ts rejects over-limit cart)
why: Regulated B2B requires spending controls enforced by the system, not by spreadsheet honour-policy
what_if_missing: Buyers could over-commit company funds, breaking the Control pillar and the procurement-governance value proposition
business_value: Control pillar for the buyer-employee and admin/sales-manager: spending caps enforced in software make over-spend structurally impossible
purpose: Prove spending governance is real and enforced at the cart boundary (the demo's spending-cap beat)
critical_thinking: Independently testable via a single over-limit cart; edge case = a cart exactly at the limit must pass (boundary inclusive); counter-view = limit changes mid-session must re-validate at completion, not at add-to-cart

title: As an admin/sales-manager I want to edit an order after placement so that I can correct line items and quantities without cancelling the order
value: Admin can adjust line items and quantities on a placed order via the admin UI
acceptance_criteria: Given a placed order, when the admin opens it in /app and edits a line-item quantity, then the order updates and the change is reflected on the buyer's order view (verify: apps/backend/src/admin/ order edit route updates order; apps/storefront/src/modules/order/ reflects change)
why: Procurement orders frequently need post-placement corrections that should not force a full cancel-and-reorder
what_if_missing: Admins must cancel and recreate orders for minor corrections, creating audit noise and buyer friction
business_value: Control + Operability pillars for the admin/sales-manager: post-placement corrections without destructive cancel-reorder cycles
purpose: Close the order-editing gap so corrections preserve order continuity and audit lineage
critical_thinking: Independently testable on a single seeded order; edge case = editing an order already converted from an approved quote must preserve the quote-to-PO linkage (do not orphan the audit trail); scored 5/6 because Small is borderline (edit + buyer-side reflection is two surfaces)

title: As a buyer-employee I want to apply a discount code at checkout so that negotiated or promotional pricing is reflected before the quote total
value: Discount codes apply at checkout and reduce the cart/quote total before approval
acceptance_criteria: Given a valid promotion code, when the buyer applies it in the checkout promotion-code field, then the discount reduces the cart total before the quote is submitted (verify: apps/storefront/src/modules/checkout/components/discount-code/ applies code; total decreases)
why: B2B pricing is frequently negotiated; promotions must reduce the quote total before approval, not after
what_if_missing: Negotiated/promotional pricing cannot be represented, so quotes show list price and approval is based on wrong totals
business_value: Speed + Cost-attribution pillars for the buyer-employee and admin/sales-manager: accurate negotiated pricing reflected pre-approval
purpose: Wire Medusa-native promotions so discounts apply before the quote total is finalised
critical_thinking: Reuses Medusa-native promotions module (no new pricing engine); edge case = an invalid/expired code must show a visible error and leave the total unchanged, never silently apply zero

title: As a finance-team member I want every approved quote to carry an immutable approver-name and timestamp record so that I can satisfy an APRA CPS 234 §36 audit
value: Each approval writes an immutable audit record (approver name + timestamp + quote-to-PO link) verifiable on demand
acceptance_criteria: Given a quote moved PENDING to APPROVED, when finance inspects the approval record, then it shows approver name, ISO-8601 timestamp, and the quote-to-PO link, and cannot be edited post-hoc (verify: apps/backend/src/workflows/approval/workflows/update-approval.ts writes immutable record; record visible in /admin/quotes)
why: Regulated FSI procurement (APRA CPS 234 §36) requires an auditable, tamper-evident approval trail
what_if_missing: Approvals leave no defensible audit trail, disqualifying the platform from any regulated-industry evaluation
business_value: Auditability + Compliance pillars for the finance-team member: a CPS 234-ready approval record that makes the audit a query, not a forensic exercise
purpose: Make the finance-approver a named, served persona (anti INVISIBLE_PRIMARY_USER for the audit role)
critical_thinking: Independently testable by approving one quote and inspecting the record; edge case = a rejected quote must also write an immutable record (rejections are auditable too); counter-view = immutability must be enforced at the data layer, not just hidden in the UI

title: As a platform-operator/HITL-manager I want all git/terraform/sensitive-AWS mutations to require my approval so that agents prepare but I decide (Principle I)
value: Principle-I governance gates block agent-initiated git/IaC/financial mutations, while READONLY queries pass
acceptance_criteria: Given an agent attempts a git/terraform/Stripe-write mutation, when the gate fires, then it exits 2 with a Principle-I message and writes a tmp/ evidence record; given a READONLY describe/list, when it runs, then it exits 0 with result rows (verify: hook exit-2 stderr in recording + tmp/ evidence; READONLY exit 0)
why: Enterprise and regulated evaluators will not adopt an agentic SDLC that can ship unreviewed infra or financial mutations
what_if_missing: Ungated autonomy reads as AI-going-rogue risk and is an instant disqualification in any regulated eval
business_value: Control + Compliance pillars for the platform-operator/HITL-manager: velocity WITH control, the governance anchor across all demo acts
purpose: Prove governable autonomy is real (agents prepare, humans decide, humans commit) not a slideware claim
critical_thinking: Must show a REAL hook exit-2 plus a READONLY command SUCCEEDING so governance reads as precise, not blanket lockdown; counter-view = a single hook is not enough, governance must span git/IaC/financial surfaces

title: As a QA engineer I want one dual-persona golden-path smoke covering buyer and admin so that no persona is silently dropped from the wedge
value: One smoke test proves quote to approval to PO across BOTH buyer and admin personas
acceptance_criteria: Given the seeded stack, when the smoke runs, then it asserts at least one buyer step AND at least one admin step in the same run (verify: b2b-smoke.spec.ts asserts >=1 buyer step AND >=1 admin step)
why: A single-persona smoke hides half the dual-persona procurement wedge
what_if_missing: A regression could silently drop one persona and the smoke would still pass, masking a broken golden path
business_value: Auditability + Compliance pillars: a regression guard that keeps both ICPs exercised in one test (anti INVISIBLE_PRIMARY_USER, test guard)
purpose: Guarantee both ICPs are exercised in every CI run via a mandatory dual-persona assertion
critical_thinking: Independently runnable against the seeded stack; edge case = storefront session hydration must be real (a soft-pass that skips the buyer assertion is testing-theater); depends on DC-011/012 existing but asserts them, it does not implement them

title: As a platform-operator I want a Terraform skeleton that validates clean with FOCUS cost tags so that the IaC is FinOps-attributable from day one
value: IaC validates clean and every resource carries FOCUS 1.2+ cost-attribution tags
acceptance_criteria: Given the terraform module, when `terraform validate` runs, then it exits 0 and the infracost JSON contains FOCUS tag keys (Service/Owner/CostCenter) (verify: terraform validate exit 0; infracost JSON has FOCUS tag keys)
why: Untagged IaC produces unattributable cloud cost and breaks the FinOps story before it starts
what_if_missing: Cost cannot be attributed by Service/Owner/CostCenter, so FinOps reporting is impossible
business_value: Cost-attribution + Operability pillars for the platform-operator: FinOps-ready IaC from day one, proven even when cost is $0
purpose: Prove tag wiring is present and correct even at zero spend
critical_thinking: FOCUS 1.2+ tags present even when cost=0; edge case = LocalStack validation must not hide a real-AWS backend defect (validate is necessary but not sufficient, see IAC_SCORING_THEATER)

title: As an SRE I want a local Grafana/Prometheus observability stack so that the platform has an operability surface from the start
value: Local Grafana + Prometheus stack provisioned for the platform per ADR-007
acceptance_criteria: Given the observability compose stack, when it starts, then Prometheus datasources are provisioned and Grafana dashboards load without manual configuration (verify: datasources provisioned; dashboards load in Grafana)
why: No observability means no operability story and blind operations
what_if_missing: Operators run blind with no SLO surface, so reliability cannot be demonstrated or improved
business_value: Operability pillar for the platform-operator: a local-first observability surface that follows ADR-007
purpose: Operationalise local-first observability so SLOs are visible before any cloud deploy
critical_thinking: Docker-compose observability stack; independently testable by booting the stack and loading a dashboard; edge case = dashboards must degrade gracefully when no metrics have been scraped yet (empty panels, not errors)

title: As an evaluator I want architecture and ADR docs so that I can assess design intent before adopting
value: Architecture and ADR documentation surface for evaluators without duplicating code
acceptance_criteria: Given the docs site, when an evaluator opens architecture.md, then it is present and links to ADRs and the golden path (verify: architecture.md + ADRs present and cross-linked; no duplicated code)
why: An undocumented platform stalls evaluation because reviewers cannot assess design intent
what_if_missing: Evaluators cannot judge the design and the adoption conversation stalls at 'show me the architecture'
business_value: Auditability pillar for the CTO/VP-Eng evaluator: an evaluable architecture surface that shortens the eval cycle
purpose: Provide an evaluable architecture surface that references rather than duplicates code
critical_thinking: Docs link the golden path rather than duplicating it (DOC references, not dup); edge case = stale ADRs are worse than none, so links must point at living code paths

title: As a demo-pipeline operator I want an environment reality gate so that no recording is ever made against a broken or stale stack
value: A one-command reality gate proves the stack is recordable before any capture begins
acceptance_criteria: Given the stack, when the reality gate runs, then storefront :8000 returns HTTP 200 with a priced product, the publishable key is derived at runtime (not hardcoded), seed is idempotent, and capture-methods.json is written (verify: 4 gate ACs pass; capture-methods.json present)
why: A recording made against a broken stack produces a fake demo that collapses under audit
what_if_missing: Records against a broken or stale stack produce slideware that destroys trust on first inspection
business_value: Operability + Auditability pillars for the demo operator: a provably recordable stack (anti SLIDEWARE env gate)
purpose: Gate every recording on a real, healthy, recordable environment
critical_thinking: Gates DC-052; runtime key derivation prevents hardcoded-key drift; edge case = an HTTP 200 that renders a not-found page is a false-green, so the gate must assert a priced product, not just a status code

title: As a HITL narrator I want a 3-act storyboard and timestamped narration so that the voiceover is repeatable across releases
value: A 3-act storyboard plus timestamped narration enables repeatable professional voiceover
acceptance_criteria: Given the demo scripts, when reviewed, then the storyboard has >=3 acts with 5W1H per act and [mm:ss] cues, and references the golden path without duplicating it (verify: storyboard >=3 acts; 5W1H per act; [mm:ss] cues; golden-path reference)
why: Without a script, narration drifts and every release re-improvises the demo
what_if_missing: Improvised demos drift each release and the narrative quality is inconsistent
business_value: Operability pillar for the HITL narrator: repeatable professional narration that references the golden path (DOC references, not dup)
purpose: Operationalise repeatable narration so the demo is reproducible per release
critical_thinking: grep gate on Act/business_value/cues keeps the script structured; edge case = timing cues must match the actual recording length or the voiceover desyncs

title: As an RQ1 evaluator I want a recorded buyer-to-PO golden path showing both personas so that the procurement wedge is proven live not as slideware
value: A recording of buyer to quote to approval to PO showing BOTH buyer and admin personas
acceptance_criteria: Given the reality gate passed, when Act 1 is recorded, then act1-buy.gif is non-empty, shows >=1 buyer AND >=1 admin step (dual-persona), produces 6 visual-verify PNGs >40KB, and logs the tool ladder (verify: act1-buy.gif non-empty; dual-persona; 6 PNGs >40KB)
why: A slideware procurement demo convinces no regulated buyer; the wedge must be shown live
what_if_missing: A single-persona recording hides half the wedge, and a slideware demo fails the 'prove it' gate
business_value: Speed + Compliance pillars: the flagship RQ1 regulated-procurement wedge proven live (anti INVISIBLE_PRIMARY_USER, recording)
purpose: Prove the regulated-procurement wedge on camera with both personas visible
critical_thinking: Depends on DC-050/051 (env gate + script); scored 5/6 because Independence is partial (recording depends on a live stack from other stories); edge case = dual-persona gate requires both windows on screen simultaneously, not sequential single-window

title: As an RQ3 developer I want a clone-to-working terminal recording under ten minutes so that fork-ability is proven not claimed
value: A terminal recording of git clone to task up to seed to healthy in <600s
acceptance_criteria: Given a fresh terminal, when Act 2 is recorded, then act2-run.gif is non-empty, shows healthy stack <600s cold-cache, idempotent-seed on screen, and an iTerm2 PNG >40KB (verify: act2-run.gif non-empty; healthy <600s; PNG >40KB)
why: Setup friction is the #1 adoption killer, so fork-ability must be shown on camera with a visible timer
what_if_missing: Hidden host dependencies cause forks to fail on a fresh laptop, and the claim 'fork in 10 minutes' stays unproven
business_value: Operability + Speed pillars for the fresh-laptop developer: a trustworthy fork in under ten minutes shown live
purpose: Prove on camera that a fresh clone reaches a working stack with no host installs
critical_thinking: Native screencapture -l window-id (no MCP dependency); edge case = the corner timer must be visible in-frame so the <600s claim is auditable, not narrated

title: As an RQ2 adopter I want a recording of /commerce:* with a Principle-I hook blocking a mutation so that governable autonomy is proven on film
value: A recording of /commerce:* with a real Principle-I hook exit-2 blocking a mutation plus an evidence trail
acceptance_criteria: Given the plugin installed, when Act 3 is recorded, then act3-adopt.gif is non-empty, shows a REAL hook exit-2 on screen, /commerce:* writes evidence to tmp/, and DC-060..062 exist in this CSV first (verify: act3-adopt.gif non-empty; real hook exit-2; tmp/ evidence)
why: Governance is the #1 agentic-SDLC adoption blocker, so it must be shown enforced, not promised
what_if_missing: Ungated autonomy shown on camera is an instant eval disqualification; a narrated claim is not proof
business_value: Control + Auditability pillars for the CTO/VP-Eng adopter: governable autonomy proven on camera (anti SLIDEWARE real hook exit-2)
purpose: Prove Principle-I enforcement is real on film with a live exit-2 block
critical_thinking: Depends on DC-060..062 being authored first (this CSV); scored 5/6 because Independence is partial (depends on hook stories existing); edge case = a narrated 'it would block' is the exact NATO violation this story disproves

title: As a scoring panel I want recorded-vs-live cross-validation plus an assembled reel so that every scene is provably real
value: Recorded-vs-live cross-validation >=99.5% plus a stitched reel and narration timing sheet
acceptance_criteria: Given all acts recorded, when cross-validation runs, then recorded==live >=99.5%, a 3-agent sequential PASS reaches >=95% agreement, a narration-timing-sheet.md exists, and PDCA is 3/3 PASS (verify: cross-validation >=99.5%; 3-agent PASS; timing sheet present)
why: An unverified demo is just marketing; staged frames collapse trust on audit
what_if_missing: Staged or unverified frames cause trust collapse the moment an auditor cross-checks against live behaviour
business_value: Auditability pillar for the scoring panel: a provably-real demo where every scene is cross-validated (anti NATO)
purpose: Guarantee the demo is evidence-backed end to end, not staged
critical_thinking: Depends on DC-052/053/054 (all acts must exist); scored 5/6 because Independence is partial (aggregates other stories); edge case = cross-validation must compare recorded frames against a fresh live run, not against the same recording

title: As a release owner I want CHANGELOG/release-notes plus a retro and next-version storyboard delta so that releases are governed and improving
value: Release artifacts (CHANGELOG, release notes, retro, storyboard delta) for a governed improving pipeline
acceptance_criteria: Given a completed demo cycle, when release prep runs, then CHANGELOG and RELEASE_NOTES are prepared for HITL to commit, a retro memory entry exists, a storyboard delta is written, and a $VERSION re-run is reproducible (verify: CHANGELOG+RELEASE_NOTES present; retro entry; storyboard delta)
why: Ungoverned releases drift and a pipeline with no retro never improves
what_if_missing: Without a retro the pipeline never improves, and ungoverned releases drift from the documented process
business_value: Operability + Control pillars for the release owner: a governed, continuously-improving demo pipeline
purpose: Operationalise governed releases with a built-in improvement loop
critical_thinking: Principle-I keeps git ops HITL-only (agent prepares CHANGELOG, HITL commits); depends on DC-055; edge case = the storyboard delta must be version-parameterised so the next release re-runs without manual edits

title: As a CTO/VP-Engineering I want to watch Principle-I gates block an agent IaC/AWS/Stripe mutation in real time so that I see velocity WITH control
value: Watch ADLC Principle-I gates actually block an agent IaC/AWS/Stripe mutation in real time
acceptance_criteria: AC1 Given the plugin installed, when an agent attempts an IaC mutation, then block-terraform-apply.sh exits 2 with a Principle-I message on screen (verify: hook stderr in recording + tmp/ evidence); AC2 Given a READONLY AWS profile, when describe/list runs, then it exits 0 with result rows (governance is precise, not blanket-deny); AC3 Given the block, then a tmp/ evidence JSON records what was attempted and why blocked (verify: test -s evidence file); AC4 >=3 distinct Principle-I hooks demonstrated across IaC/aws-mutation/stripe-write-key (verify: grep -c hook names >=3)
why: CTOs fear autonomous agents shipping unreviewed infra or financial mutations; governance is the #1 adoption blocker for agentic SDLC
what_if_missing: Without a visible block the framework looks like ungated autonomy, an instant disqualification in any regulated or enterprise evaluation
business_value: Converts the 'AI will go rogue' objection into 'AI prepares, humans commit' proof, unblocking enterprise pilot conversations for the CTO/VP-Eng primary RQ2 persona
purpose: Prove governable autonomy: velocity with Principle-I control, not slideware claims
critical_thinking: Must show a REAL hook exit-2, not a narrated claim (anti NATO_VIOLATION/slideware); must also show a READONLY command SUCCEEDING so governance reads as precise, not blanket lockdown

title: As a dev-agency/SI tech lead I want to fork the Commerce plugin into my own repo with a clean evidence trail so that I deliver client B2B faster while keeping my own audit record
value: Fork the Commerce plugin into my own repo and run /commerce:* against my own client stack with a clean evidence trail
acceptance_criteria: AC1 Given a fresh clone, when the SI runs the documented fork/install, then /commerce:* is discoverable with >=14 commands listed (verify: command count >=14); AC2 Given the plugin installed, when the SI runs /commerce:visual-verify or tf-plan, then evidence is written to tmp/ in the SI's OWN repo, portable and not hardcoded to OceanSoft paths (verify: test -s evidence in SI workspace); AC3 Given the borrow-as-init-draft IP stance, then licensing/ownership is unambiguous (OceanSoft owns from v0.1.0; SI owns their fork; verify: doc reference present); AC4 fork to first /commerce success in <30min (verify: timing evidence)
why: SIs are a force-multiplier channel; they adopt only if the plugin is forkable and produces their own audit trail, not vendor-locked
what_if_missing: If commands are hardcoded to OceanSoft paths or undocumented, SIs cannot resell and channel adoption is zero
business_value: Each SI becomes a distribution node: one plugin maps to many client deployments, multiplying reach for the dev-agency/SI secondary RQ2 persona without OceanSoft headcount
purpose: Prove the plugin is a reusable product surface, not a one-customer bespoke artifact
critical_thinking: Must verify path-portability (no /Volumes/Working hardcodes leaking into the SI workspace); anti INVISIBLE_PRIMARY_USER makes the SI a named ICP

title: As a CTO/VP-Eng and SI I want to follow one /commerce:* command end-to-end and see its PDCA evidence trail so that I can verify claims are evidence-backed before adopting
value: Follow one /commerce:* command end-to-end and see its PDCA evidence trail (coordination log to execution to cross-validation JSON)
acceptance_criteria: AC1 Given /commerce:tf-plan runs, when it completes, then a coordination log + execution evidence + verify output exist in tmp/ (verify: 3 evidence files present); AC2 Given the evidence trail, then every business-value claim has an evidence path with no NATO (verify: claims-to-evidence mapping); AC3 Given the PDCA loop, then a >=99.5% cross-validation or 3-agent-PASS artifact is visible (verify: pdca-evidence JSON); AC4 100% of demonstrated claims have an evidence path (verify: claim/evidence ratio == 1.0)
why: Evaluators distrust unsubstantiated 'AI productivity' claims; the evidence trail IS the differentiator versus hype tools
what_if_missing: Without an auditable trail, adoption stalls at 'prove it' and the framework reads as marketing
business_value: Evidence-backed claims shorten enterprise eval cycles; 'no NATO' becomes a competitive moat for the shared CTO/SI RQ2 evidence-trail concern
purpose: Demonstrate the framework's core discipline (evidence over talk) as a buyable property
critical_thinking: The demo of evidence must ITSELF be evidence-backed (meta-honesty); claiming PDCA without showing the JSON is the exact NATO_VIOLATION this story disproves

title: As a HITL narrator I want a skill that assembles per-act GIFs into a narrated reel with voiceover cues so that reel production is repeatable
value: A skill that assembles per-act GIFs into a narrated reel with voiceover cues
acceptance_criteria: Given the per-act GIFs and narration-timing-sheet, when the skill runs, then it is discoverable, takes act GIFs + timing sheet as input, and outputs a stitched reel reference (verify: skill present and discoverable; reel reference output)
why: Manual reel assembly is slow and non-repeatable
what_if_missing: Without a reusable assembly step, every release re-improvises the reel and quality varies
business_value: Operability pillar for the HITL narrator: repeatable narrated reel production per release
purpose: Operationalise the assembly phase as a reusable skill
critical_thinking: Skill is the operational owner of the assembly phase and is reusable across releases; edge case = concat must use a filter (not -c copy) to avoid timebase corruption when stitching

title: As a buyer-employee I want to paste multiple SKU/quantity lines and bulk-add them to my cart so that I can reorder at procurement scale without searching each product
value: Paste multiple SKU,quantity lines and add them all to the cart in one bulk action to reorder without per-product search
acceptance_criteria: AC1 Given >=2 valid SKU,qty lines pasted, when Add to Cart runs, then one bulk POST adds each line at the correct quantity (verify: apps/storefront/src/modules/products/components/quick-order-pad/ + tmp/B2B-Commerce/screenshots/quick-order-pad-ac1-after-add.png + cart line count); AC2 Given an unknown SKU, then a visible per-line error shows and valid lines still add (verify: quick-order-pad-ac2-unknown-sku.png); AC3 Given an empty/malformed line, then it is rejected with a message and the button is disabled (verify: quick-order-pad-ac3-malformed.png); AC4 Given SKUs, then they resolve to variant_id via /store/products?variants[sku] exact-match (verify: curl 200 resolution)
why: B2B reorder is list-driven; per-product search is too slow for procurement-size carts
what_if_missing: Buyers do large reorders one-by-one or abandon them, creating friction in the highest-value B2B flow
business_value: Speed pillar for the buyer-employee: faster list-based reorder reduces buyer effort on repeat purchases (qualitative; no measured percentage yet)
purpose: Close the genuine B2B bulk-entry gap (the existing variants-table only handles one product's variants)
critical_thinking: Reuses the proven addToCartBulk + existing bulk endpoint (no new cart system); unknown-SKU errors are visible and never silent-drop; verified with real seeded SKUs (WEBCAM-BLACK/MOUSE-WHITE), no mocks
